_metadata.description: DC vs KKR IPL 2026 match 152064, DC innings, overs 1-6 (balls 0.1-5.6). Per-ball ground truth ledger derived from Cricbuzz commentary. Used by files/tests/test_sm_derivation_ledger.py.

conventions.ball_id: Cricket overs notation: 'O.B' where O is completed overs (0-indexed in SM terms) and B is balls-into-current-over (1-6 for legal balls).
conventions.overs_field: SM's overs string, post-ball state. After the 6th ball of over O, overs becomes 'O+1.0' (rollover).
conventions.over_history_keys: 0-indexed integer keys matching SM internals (over 1 → '0', over 2 → '1', etc.). Ground truth markdown uses 1-indexed for human readability; this ledger re-maps to SM-internal.
conventions.this_over_post_rollover: After the 6th-ball commit of an over, this_over resets to [] in the same SM commit cycle. expected_state_after.this_over for ball X.6 is therefore [].
conventions.bowler_overs: Standard 'O.B' notation. balls field included separately for unambiguous comparison.
conventions.partnership_after_wicket: Per-ball expected_state_after.partnership reflects the ACTIVE partnership at that moment. For the wicket ball itself, partnership shape is the just-ended pair (since the dismissed batter faced the ball); the new partnership starts at the NEXT ball at 0/0.
conventions.cold_start_window: Pipeline cold-start synthesis covers balls 0.1-0.2 (initial 4/0 read backfilled to Nissanka 4(2), Roy 0.2/4). Harness implementers may choose to seed SM at the cold-start exit state and start replay at ball 0.3, or drive every ball through SM and validate cold-start path separately.
